hvir is a desktop Electron app for working with local and SSH projects: browse files, review diffs, run terminals, and launch coding-agent harnesses without turning the editor into the center of gravity.

## Features

- **View-first workbench** — file tree, tabbed viewer, Git rail, terminals, and a web pane in one window
- **Local and remote workspaces** — open folders on the local machine or over SSH
- **File viewer** — source, rendered, and diff modes; Markdown, Mermaid, HTML, JSON, YAML, CSV, and images
- **Git** — status, history, graph, worktrees, branch switch, fetch, and pull
- **Terminals** — native PTYs rendered with [ghostty-web](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/ghostty-web)
- **Agent harnesses** — bundled launch profiles for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cursor CLI, Pi, a plain shell, and custom commands
- **Document review** — prepare and send review context into a trusted harness
- **Sessions** — observe running terminal and harness sessions across workspaces

Packaged builds currently target **macOS** (`.pkg`) and **Linux** (`.deb`).

## Requirements

- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) 24 or later
- A C/C++ toolchain for native addons (`node-gyp`, `node-pty`, and `@hvir/rename-noreplace`)
- Git, if you want repository features

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir.git
cd hvir
npm install
npm run dev
```

`npm install` rebuilds native modules against Electron. `npm run dev` starts the electron-vite development app.

Optional local Git hooks (typecheck plus a platform smoke test on push):

```bash
npm run hooks:install
```

## Scripts

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Run the Electron app in development |
| `npm run build` | Typecheck and production-build |
| `npm test` | Run the Vitest suite |
| `npm run lint` | ESLint |
| `npm run format` | Prettier write |
| `npm run verify` | Seams, architecture, lint, typecheck, and tests |
| `npm run smoke` | Headless Electron smoke scenarios |
| `npm run pack:mac:arm64` | macOS `.pkg` (arm64) |
| `npm run pack:linux:x64` | Linux `.deb` (x64) |
| `npm run pack:linux:arm64` | Linux `.deb` (arm64) |

## Architecture

The process split is the usual Electron layout, with host I/O kept behind explicit seams:

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `src/main` | Application runtime, IPC, PTY, Git, SSH, harnesses |
| `src/preload` | Sandboxed bridge (`ipcRenderer` stays here) |
| `src/renderer` | React workbench UI |
| `src/shared` | Types and contracts shared across processes |
| `src/workers` | Isolated Git (and echo) workers |
| `packages/rename-noreplace` | Native no-replace rename binding |

Host primitives (`fs`, `child_process`, `chokidar`, `node-pty`) are confined to the local project-host implementation. PTY spawn goes through the PTY supervisor. `npm run check-seams` and ESLint enforce those boundaries.

## Contributing

Bug reports, feature ideas, and questions belong in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/jarmak-personal/hvir/discussions).

Before opening a change, run:

```bash
npm run verify
```
